method_note: BSE 526433. Only one earnings call in the 8-quarter window: Q2 FY26 (10 Nov 2025), which the MD called the company's first call (transcript p.2; an analyst calls it the 'maiden analyst conference call', p.8). BSE announcement feed checked 1 Oct 2024 - 8 Oct 2026: the only earnings-call filings are the Q2 FY26 audio (10 Nov 2025) and transcript (14 Nov 2025); other quarters have results and investor presentations only (Analyst/Investor Meet intimations are group meetings, not calls). Management refused forward guidance on the call; per rule that is not a class-9 withdrawal (company never guided). Anchored qualitative statements converted to the figure in force when said. Quotes from text extraction of the BSE transcript PDF, printed page numbers. Outcomes from company investor presentations (consolidated) and the FY26 audited results; Reg-33 quarterly results PDFs are scanned images. No class-10 assurance contradicted; no override. grade maps to engine_v3 score. Single graded call makes this a thin credibility record.
